discovery.detail: Every reachable JSX binding is resolved by TypeScript declarations; route roots traverse direct JSX and HOC/alias references. Module-only capabilities remain conditional source records, not actual route UI. Four renderless/HOC local capabilities and four no-import component files are retained. This classifies source reachability; entry conditions remain explicit, without formal prop-combination satisfiability claims.

Definitions and route requirement templates are distinct from actual instances. Runtime identity is source definition + observation run/id + route/mode + fixture business key (symbol, contract tuple, report run/category, proposal/fold, alert rule ID); nested Fields uses parent key path/array item index within frozen row. No production finite-instance count. Two integrated rows per each of three modes prove selected-row identity and raw open/close reset.

All reachable JSX occurrences (native and custom), source-discovered native candidates, CSS hover/focus/pseudo/visibility blocks and imperative render/factory calls have stable source IDs/classifications. Custom bindings, HOCs/aliases and renderless chart capability references remain source-owned conditional requirements. TradeCard has one route JSX caller with no decisionTarget: inline branch reachable, portal/null alternatives retained API capabilities with route N/A. Third-party canvas internals are an H/J requirement, not independently enumerated DOM menus.

Every definition has nine source-supported or ancestor/prop-controlled state entry contracts, referenced by every native/route requirement ID. Special-value props/ReactNode paths remain fixture obligations even in pure primitives; no blanket N/A is assigned. Applicability discovery is distinct from executing domain values and validating correctness. Parent-controlled async/visibility uses exact source hooks/conditions and caller references.

Hard slot associations are the exact page when present or nearest applicable default listed in attached_entry_sources. Soft navigation retains prior active slot when destination unmatched. Fourteen paired histories bind retained-origin source ID and expected hard-entry ID; identical QuickLook DOM is disambiguated by source route binding, never text alone. Calendar/Settings retained Portfolio/Watchlist rail findings are tracked in separate phase395.

__test-crash is a Next private folder; dev URL actual root404 is recorded, and integrated dev app-paths manifest has no crash entry. NODE_ENV guard inside this excluded source does not expose a production route. This is source/dev-manifest exposure discovery, not a production deployment test. Frame error coverage instead uses malformed isolated events mock and Retry.
Browser storage reload and backend recovery mocks exist; no actual backend process/database restart performed or certified. Source config hash update is provenance only.

Per-route ownership uses union of definition owners and route owners, with I persistence/J presentation/A navigation always explicit. Shared chart, score, report and execution widgets are multi-lane handoffs; union is responsibility discovery, not any lane arithmetic approval. Each normalized state inherits these owners and reload-restart I.
